gen-dafont-nordic-gf-aldrich: Aldrich reads modern and upright, its x-height close to the capitals and its round letters cupped open. Nordic then adds an ancient, tightly folded heading, so extended text beneath it moves along like tracing one thick thread.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-anek-bangla: Ancient and forceful: Nordic cuts every stroke to one depth, tightly closed, while the spacing drifts wide. Anek Bangla replies with open, wide-curved s shapes and short ascenders that keep the text friendly.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-anek-gujarati: Powerful and ancient, Nordic draws every line flat and unmodulated, with letters folded tight. But Anek Gujarati gapes open in its c and lifts its lowercase toward capital height, giving the heading space to breathe.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Anek Gurmukhi is sans-serif at heart, with generous counters in every small letter and curves that stay wide open. Nordic's tight, closed forms make it a powerful, ancient counterweight.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-anek-odia: Strong, ancient lines: Nordic keeps one monoline stroke throughout, closed tight, while Anek Odia leaves its rounds unlatched. Long runs of that sans text would read clean and contemporary.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-carrois-gothic: Powerful and ancient, Nordic draws letters that read like outlines in one width. Carrois Gothic, sans-serif with a generous c and a high-set x-height, carries extended text in a modern, businesslike way.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Nordic's rounded-wire strokes look bent from a single length, closed tight and spaced far apart. Carrois Gothic SC opens every curve and keeps capitals and lowercase nearly level, a sans that stays friendly.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Heavy wire, ancient bite: Nordic strokes stay uniform from end to end. Hedvig Letters Sans, a sans with a broad gap in its c and near-capital lowercase, would feel approachable and contemporary across long text.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-hind-madurai: Nordic is tight, closed and ancient, with spacing spread wide. Against it, Hind Madurai's broad s curves and capital-high lowercase make the open-versus-closed difference the whole point.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-hind-siliguri: Powerful and ancient, Nordic is built for impact, closed tight. Hind Siliguri does the opposite job, holding a flat gray hum with gapped rounds and a gentle step up to capitals.
